1/4 small red onion, finely diced
1/4 green pepper, finely diced

12 tsp chopped fresh green chilli
Salt and pepper!

caption:
One of my favourite signs of warmer weather is seeing Ontario asparagus back in season! 🌱 [AD]

The season is short from mid-May to early July so now is the perfect time to enjoy it while it’s fresh and local.

I turned a bunch of @ontario.asparagus into this cheesy baked one pot dish. It’s simple to prepare, packed with flavour and pairs perfectly with almost any meal.

Ontario asparagus is one of those vegetables that makes cooking easy. Just wash, trim, and cook. It can be roasted, grilled, baked, steamed or added to your favourite recipes.

📌 Save this recipe to try before asparagus season wraps up!
 
Cheesy Baked Asparagus

Ingredients:
- 1 bunch Ontario asparagus, trimmed
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- salt and black pepper, to taste
- 2 cloves garlic
- 1/2 cup cottage cheese (blended)
- 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
Optional Garnish: Chopped parsley

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F) and grease a baking dish with olive oil.
2. Arrange asparagus in a single layer in the dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. Add garlic.
3. In a blender, blend the cottage cheese then pour it over the asparagus. Top with mozzarella cheese.
4. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
5. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.

caption:
From watching my Ami cook… to cooking the same dish for my daughter. Time really does fly! 

Try this fruit custard trifle for ramadan and eid. It’s such an easy yet elevated dessert idea for Ramadan and Eid

Ingredients:
-345 gm golden sliced loaf cake
-1.5 cups milk
-5 tbsp @nationalfoodsglobal vanilla custard
-1 packet or 80g Rafhan Strawberry Jelly
-1/2 can of @dolecanadaofficial pineapple tidbits
-2 apple shredded (skin peeled off)
-1 cup whipping cream @lactantia 
-3 tbsp icing sugar @redpathsugar 

Method:
1. In a deep dish add the loaf cake (crushed into very small pieces). Layer it tightly
2. Now add some pineapple juice from the can generously to make the cake layer soft
3. Then add the shredded apples + pineapple tidbits
4. Prepare the custard according to package instructions. You want to make sure the custard is of thick consistency 
5. Once the custard is ready add the custard layer on top of the cake + fruits.
6. Wait for the custard layer to cool down and meanwhile prepare the strawberry jelly according to package instructions. Add the strawberry jelly layer slowly and gradually with a spoon on top of the custard layer. Refrigerate and wait for the jelly to set

#AD Still dreaming about the Dubai chocolate strawberry cup? 🍓✨ If you’re like me and don’t want to stand in long lines, here’s how you can make it at home — with the juiciest, sweetest California strawberries. 
 
Not only are they delicious, but strawberries are one of the healthiest fresh fruits.
A serving of 8 strawberries is only 50 calories with 3 g of fibre and 95% of your daily value of vitamin C.
 
 And the best part? @castrawberries are incredibly versatile — perfect in decadent desserts like this kunafa cup, refreshing summer salads, or cozy winter baking.
🍰🥗 
 
👉 For more on strawberry health benefits, visit
californiastrawberries.com/health-wellness 

•Ingredients: 

-10-12 California strawberries 
-2cups kataifi pastry 
-1tbsp butter 
-6 oz pistachio cream 
-2 milk chocolate bars (you will only use 1 and a half bars) 
-1 tbsp crushed pistachios (for garnish) 
 
•Instructions: 

-Cut the kataifi into smaller shreds then sauté it in a skillet with butter until golden and crispy, stirring constantly 
-Allow it to cool then mix with pistachio cream 
-Melt chocolate 
-Wash and cut your California strawberries
-Now assemble starting with California strawberries at the bottom, then the pistachio kataifi mix, then melted chocolate. Repeat this one more time and finish off with crushed pistachios
 and more juicy strawberries.

caption:
🥢 Quick Stir-Fry Asparagus with Rice 🍚✨

Did you know Ontario asparagus is in peak season from May to early July? That means it’s the perfect time to enjoy this fresh, spring veggie while supporting local farm families 💚 

Here’s my easy, flavourful stir-fry asparagus recipe — ready in under 30 minutes!

📝 What you’ll need:

🧄 3-4 garlic cloves, minced

🫚 1-inch fresh ginger, minced

🧅 1/4 cup red onions

🫑 1/4 cup green peppers

🥕 1/4 cup julienned carrots

🥬 1 bunch Ontario asparagus, trimmed & chopped

🫛 1 tsp soy sauce + 1/2 tsp black pepper + salt to taste

🍚 1 1/2 cups cooked rice

👩🏻‍🍳 How to make it:

1️⃣ Sauté garlic and ginger in oil until fragrant.

2️⃣ Add onions, peppers, carrots & asparagus. Cook on high heat for 3–4 mins.

3️⃣ Toss in soy sauce, black pepper, and salt. Serve with rice enjoy. You can even pair it with your favourite protein to make it a meal 🥘 

✨ Asparagus is not only fast and easy to cook — it’s also super versatile and a great value when it’s in season. A ½ cup is 1 serving so one bunch provides 4-6 servings (depending on how thick each spear is.) Buying Ontario asparagus helps keep Ontario’s agricultural community strong. 🌱

Some Ramadan recipes just feel like home, and this is one of them. Crispy, golden chicken patties with warm milk tea ☕️✨ it’s the suhoor and iftar combo that never gets old.
 
Made with @MapleLeafFoods Mina Halal Zabeeha by hand chicken for that authentic taste, just like my mom’s recipe and the best part? It’s made in Canada! 🇨🇦 #MinaHalal

Ingredients:
-1 cup boiled and shredded boneless chicken breast
-2 tbsp butter
-1 small onion finely chopped
-½ tsp salt
-½ tsp pepper
-2 tbsp flour
-½ cup milk
-Puff Pastry sheets
-Cookie cutter

Method:
-Boil the chicken breast with water, salt and pepper. Once boiled, shred it using a fork
-In a pan, melt butter and add chopped onions. Cook till translucent 
-Now add in the flour, milk and seasoning. Once it thickens add the chicken. The mixture is ready
-On a tray, spread your puff pastry sheets and use cookie cutter to shape your patties
-Add 1 tbsp of chicken mix on to each round, top it with another round. And seal the edges
-Brush with egg wash and bake in preheated oven at 375 F for 20 minutes or until golden brown

caption:
Nothing says holiday magic like Christmas Tree Brownies! Made with @truvia Sweet Complete Granulated From Stevia Leaf, Brown and Icing sweeteners for a festive treat that’s big on flavor, light on sugar. 🎄💫 #TruviaPartner
 
Ingredients:
For brownies
-1 ¼ cup Truvia Sweet Complete Granulated from the Stevia Leaf
-¼ cup Truvia Sweet Complete Brown
-½ cup unsalted butter
-½ tsp salt
-⅔ cup unsweetened cocoa powder
-1 tsp vanilla extract
-2 tbsp vegetable oil
-2 tbsp heavy cream
-2 large eggs
-¾ cups all purpose flour
-½ cup dark chocolate chips
 
For Icing:
-1 cup heavy/ whipping cream
-½ cup Truvia Sweet Complete Icing
-1 tsp of green food coloring
-holiday sprinkles (optional)
 
Method:
1. Whisk together the unsalted butter, Truvia Sweet Complete Granulated from Stevia Leaf and the Truvia Sweet Complete Brown until smooth and fluffy
2. Then add the unsweetened cocoa powder, salt, vanilla extract, vegetable oil and heavy cream. Whisk again
3. Once smooth add in the eggs and beat for about a minute till the eggs are well combined and the batter is fluffy
4. Now add the all purpose flour and fold it in lightly
5. Finally mix in the chocolate chips
6. Transfer the batter to a 9x9 baking tray lined with parchment paper
7. Bake in the oven at 350 F for about 30-35 mins. Once they’re out of the oven, allow them to cool down for about 20 minutes then cut them into triangles
8. Prepare the icing by beating together heavy cream and Truvia Sweet Complete Icing till you have a thick consistency. Then add in the green food coloring and fold that in the cream
9. After the brownies have cooled down, pipe the green icing in a zigzag pattern. Add a candy cane at the bottom of the brownie. Top with some holiday sprinkles

Looking for the perfect Diwali snack that’s sure to impress your friends and family? These potato patty wraps are the ultimate festive treat! {#AD}

Picture this: toasted tortilla filled with veggies & potato patty with a slice of melty cheese, and the secret ingredient that takes the recipe to the next level—Hellmann’s Vegan Mayonnaise.
 
Hellmann’s creamy and rich flavour brings everything together, making each bite a burst of deliciousness. Whether you’re hosting a Diwali gathering or simply enjoying with family, these wraps are a quick and easy way to add a modern twist to your celebrations.
 
#PartenaireHellmannsCanada  #HellmannsCanadaPartner @hellmannscanada
 
Ingredients:
 
•For potato patty
-4 potatoes boiled & mashed
-½ tsp red chilli powder
-1 tsp salt
-½ tsp lemon juice
-½ tsp cumin powder
-handful of fresh cilantro
 
•For Hellmann’s Vegan Mayonnaise with tandoori spices
-½ cup @hellmannscanada Vegan Mayonnaise
-¼ tsp red chilli powder
-¼ tsp all spices powder
-¼ tsp turmeric powder
-¼ tsp ketchup
 
•other ingredients for the wrap
-5 tortilla wraps
-5 cheddar cheese slices
-¼ cup @hellmannscanada garlic aioli
-5 lettuce leaves
-¼ cup pizza sauce
-¼ cup sliced onions and green pepper
 
Method:
1.Prepare the Hellmann’s Vegan Mayonnaise with tandoori spices by adding all the ingredients in a bowl. Mix well and set aside
2. Prepare the potato patty mixture by boiling and mashing the potatoes. Add all the spices, lemon juice and fresh cilantro. Shape them into round patties and fry them
3. Assemble: place a tortilla wrap and cut halfway from the middle. Now in one corner, spread the Hellmann’s Vegan Mayonnaise with tandoori spices and add lettuce. In the second corner add pizza sauce + veggies. In the 3rd corner spread Hellmann’s Garlic Aioli and add the fried potato patty on top. In the last corner add the cheddar cheese slice. Now fold the tortilla and lightly toast it on medium low heat till the cheese has melted

caption:
Traditional pakistani style fruit trifle perfect for the holiday season! 😋 

Now there are alot of variations for this recipe but this is how my mom made it that day and I decided to share it with you guys ✨

Ingredients:
-345 gm golden sliced loaf cake
-1 L milk
-5 tbsp @nationalfoodsglobal vanilla custard
-1 packet or 80g Rafhan Strawberry Jelly
-1/2 can of @dolecanadaofficial pineapple tidbits
-1 apple shredded (skin peeled off)
-1/2 cup whipping cream @lactantia 
-2 tbsp icing sugar @redpathsugar 

Method:
1. In a deep dish add the loaf cake (crushed into very small pieces). Layer it tightly
2. Now add some pineapple juice from the can generously to make the cake layer soft
3. Then add the shredded apples + pineapple tidbits
4. Prepare the custard according to package instructions. You want to make sure the custard is of thick consistency 
5. Once the custard is ready add the custard layer on top of the cake + fruits.
6. Wait for the custard layer to cool down and meanwhile prepare the strawberry jelly according to package instructions. Add the strawberry jelly layer slowly and gradually with a spoon on top of the custard layer
7. Finally beat the whipping cream with icing sugar and add that on top. This is the final layer. Garnish with some pineapples. Refrigerate and serve!

caption:
Elevate your dessert game with these Rice Pudding Tarts!

A taste of tradition with a twist. Super easy to make and looks so pretty!

Recipe below

Ingredients:
•100gm of @laxmifoodsbrand extra long basmati rice (soaked for 30 minutes & drained)
•1 L full fat/ 3.25% milk
•1/2 cup finely granulated sugar
•2-3 green cardamom pods (discard later)
•Pistachios and Almonds roughly chopped
•Store bought pre made/ Frozen Tart Shells

Method:
•Place the soaked, drained rice in a food processor and whizz until rice is coarsely broken up
•Bring milk to a slow boil, add cardamom and the rice
•Keep stirring and then add in the sugar
•Keep cooking and stirring till the rice is cooked through and appears like little bubbles and the pudding attains a thick consistency
•Once that is done, turn off the heat and add your chopped nuts
•Place the rice pudding in the fridge once it’s cooled down so that you can serve it chilled
•Bake the tart shells according to package instructions and let them cool
•When you are ready to serve fill the shells with 1 tbsp of chilled rice pudding and add some more nuts on top

-5 oz cherry tomatoes

•Directions:
-Pre heat oven to 350 F
-Place the mini skull silicone molds on a baking tray. Fill the molds with pieces of bocconcini cheese and bake for 4-5 minutes till the cheese melts
-Remove from oven, let it rest and cool completely
-Cut the cherry tomatoes in half, season with olive oil, salt, pepper and chilli flakes and bake it at 400 F for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside
-Place the Furlani Garlic Parm Texas Toast slices on a baking tray and follow the package baking instructions
-Add a layer of basil pesto, then the roasted cherry tomatoes and top them up with 4-5 skull shaped mozzarella
